A1d.proof: Both objectives strictly concave on [0,1]; social derivative reaches zero only at the upper endpoint, private derivative at 1/2. Zero current output is admissible under the stated linear objective.

A2a.proof: Feasible saving has lower bound -4 and upper log-consumption domain 30 (34 after tax shift); strictly concave objective has a negative derivative at the borrowing boundary in both cases. PV wealth remains 90.

A3c.proof: Unrestricted candidate violates j>=-2; floor solution satisfies original max rule. The piecewise monotone rule and IS equation select one consistent regime.

A3d.scope: Finite positive cost-shock variance ensures a finite nonzero regressor variance. Movement along demand is not identification of positive pricing slope.

A4b.scope: Global affine stability applies without cap; capped dynamics are not the same law.

project_review: Derived the goods closure independently as Y=(10+I0+G+30+20000 psi)/(1/2+100 psi). In the fixed baseline c0=55/4 is the composite of autonomous 43/4 plus c times domestic public interest 4, while external interest is 5 H. Hence C=10+(3/5)Y. Public interest is an internal transfer, included once in household receipts and subtracted once in public saving; it is not added to GDP or foreign income.

The denominator is strictly positive on the supplied domains c<1, tax/import shares nonnegative and feedback nonnegative. The affine goods-market solution is unique; the code separately rejects negative consumption/investment, zero GDP and negative debt/issuance requiring a new asset policy. None of the five solutions is silently clipped into a positive-activity solution.

Compared all 24 named numeric scenario outputs with an independent exact Fraction oracle, rather than calling the benchmark helper to derive expected values. All eight accounting residuals are zero for each of five scenarios. The public purchases offset candidate has a domestic funding gap of 4 and is explicitly conditional/infeasible under the fixed issuance cap unless financing changes.

Foreign amounts are F and home flows H at e=2 H/F throughout the opening-to-closing bridge. The full opening external principal 20 F is repaid; its interest 5/2 F enters CA, principal does not. New private 10 F and required official lending replace debt. Reserves are the sole external asset. With unchanged e, no valuation is inserted and Delta NFA=CA. Official lending is a needed amount, not a promised approval.

Independently checked historical transformations of supplied rounded inputs: quarterly real growth about 0.57010612897%; implied annualized deflator growth 200/93 percent; constant 0.4% monthly CPI compounded gives about 4.90702075348% annually, not a forecast; rounded employment ratios give naive unemployment 4% versus separately reported 4.1%; revision -8.2 billion USD, same-vintage change -35.9 and mixed-vintage change -44.1.

Inspected all twelve observation records: each supplies period, release date, vintage, units, frequency, adjustment and official source URL. All source-document release dates are no later than the declared January 30 2025 cutoff. The previous Q2 CA value is explicitly a restatement in the December source rather than falsely assigning its original vintage release date. Historical values are separate from uncalibrated synthetic coefficients.

Read the complete benchmark source; quiet import, strict JSON serialization through its documented Fraction encoder and normal/-O CLI from /private/tmp were successful. Eight independently changed invalid domains/IDs/future release-date inputs raised ValueError. No claim of exhaustive adversarial validation is made.
section_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 text beginning with the listed h2 marker and ending immediately before the next listed h2 marker, including intervening whitespace. The full manuscript is intentionally not hashed because Form B and project prose are outside this pass and still changing.
limitations: This peer pass inspected the historical extract metadata and recomputed transformations but did not reopen the BEA/BLS source bodies. Primary verification of those archive facts is not claimed here; root separately owns source inspection.
The benchmark checks release dates at calendar-date resolution; the exact same-day 08:30 cutoff relies on the supplied source provenance rather than an intraday timestamp validator.
Model coefficients and scenario closures are maintained assumptions, not causal estimates or calibrated U.S. forecasts. Globality claims are limited to the stated domains and regimes.
Root is still writing Form B and the project narrative. This record does not accept those unreviewed sections, the complete volume assessment, or the library.
No manuscript, project data/program, shared state or publishing file was changed by this peer audit; only this review artifact was authored.
